records.source: Read this to gain some experience in all skills.
records.translation: Basahin ito upang magkaroon ng kaunting karanasan sa lahat ng kasanayan.

records.source: A rare mushroom found deep in caves.
records.translation: Bihirang kabuteng matatagpuan sa kailaliman ng mga kuweba.

records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
records.translation: Maaaring mapisa sa Pampapisa ng Slime.
records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: Plant these in any season. Water every day to produce a Qi Fruit. Takes 4 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa anumang panahon. Diligan araw-araw upang mamunga ng Bunga ni Qi. Tumatagal ng 4 na araw upang mahinog.

records.source: Mr. Qi has challenged you to ship 500 of these strange melons.
records.translation: Hinamon ka ni G. Qi na magpadala ng 500 sa mga kakaibang melong ito.

records.source: A special currency honored by Mr. Qi.
records.translation: Natatanging salaping kinikilala ni G. Qi.

records.source: Just a dash will elevate any dish to extraordinary heights. Automatically applied when cooking.
records.translation: Sapat na ang kaunting budbod upang gawing pambihira ang anumang pagkain. Awtomatikong inilalagay kapag nagluluto.

records.source: Boosts the quality of fish that you catch.
records.translation: Pinatataas ang kalidad ng mga isdang nahuhuli mo.

records.source: Improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Pinahuhusay ang kalidad ng lupa at pinatataas ang tsansang makapagpatubo ng de-kalidad na pananim. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.source: This soil has a good chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Malaki ang tsansang manatiling basa ang lupang ito magdamag. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.source: Waters the 8 adjacent tiles every morning.
records.translation: Dinidiligan ang 8 katabing parisukat tuwing umaga.

records.source: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
records.translation: Malinaw na kristal na karaniwang matatagpuan sa mga kuweba at minahan.
Sinasabi ng ilan na nagdadala ito ng suwerte.

records.source: Known by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.
records.translation: Ayon sa Komisyon sa Kaligtasan ng Lungsod ng Zuzu, nagdudulot ito ng permanenteng pinsala sa katawan.

records.source: A carp that spent one too many years in toxic sludge.
records.translation: Karpang napakatagal na nanirahan sa nakalalasong burak.

records.source: It's glowing with dangerous energy... Can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: Kumikinang ito sa mapanganib na enerhiya... Maaaring tunawin upang maging mga lingote.

records.source: A crisp and refreshing root vegetable with hints of pepper when eaten raw.
records.translation: Malutong at nakagiginhawang ugat na gulay na bahagyang lasang paminta kapag kinakain nang hilaw.
